description: Which store-shard test files the Postgres leg (lane server-store-pg) runs [POD-6980, POD-6958 design 2.10].
The leg runs every file of the store shard (test-shards.json) except the two lists below.
sqliteOnly: the file's subject is SQLite itself. Each entry says why. It never runs on Postgres.

pending: the file is meant to run on both engines but has not been converted yet. A task that makes a file pass on Postgres removes it here; the list is empty when the Postgres store is complete (POD-6994).
Paths are relative to the repository root. src/store/test-store-engines.test.ts checks that every entry is a store-shard file and that no file is in both lists.

Runs the identity suite on its SQLite schema; the identity package tests its Postgres twin itself.
